BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION SP/2025)
CLASS:  BBA/IMBA   SEMESTER : II
BRANCH: BBA/IMBA   SESSION : SP/2025

SUBJECT: MN110 WEB APPLICATION OF BUSINESS
TIME 02 Hours   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The question paper contains 5 questions each of 5 marks and total 25 marks.
2. Attempt all questions.
3. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
4. Tables/Data handbook/Graph paper etc., if applicable, will be supplied to the candidates
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

   CO BL
Q.1(a) Differentiate between the Internet and the World Wide Web (WWW). [2] 1 1
Q.1(b) Define the Internet. How does it enable communication between devices globally? [3] 1 1


Q.2(a) State one key difference between E-commerce and EDI. [2] 1 1
Q.2(b) Define the term EDI (Electronic Data Interchange), and how it benefits businesses. [3] 1 1


Q.3(a) Write the HTML code for creating a webpage with a heading and a paragraph. [2] 2 2
Q.3(b) Write the HTML code to create a table with three rows and three columns [3] 2 3


Q.4(a) Write the HTML code to create a simple unordered list with three items. [2] 2 3
Q.4(b) Write HTML code for the following listing:
1. Fruits
a. Apple
b. Banana
c. Grapes
2. Coffee
i. Normal
ii. cold
           iii.         Hot
[3] 2 3


Q.5(a) What is CSS? Explain its importance in web development. [2] 3 1
Q.5(b) List and briefly describe the three types of CSS. [3] 3 2
